column1: # Lamakan finale: Ash Jenna's reveal, the echoes, the choice and three endings.

column3: You kept walking, and that\nearns you an answer. I'll\ntell you what I am.{end_wait}
You aren't our Jenna. Then\nwho are you?{end_wait}

A Jenna from a world the
Wise One burned.{page_break}I'm the one he couldn't
kill. The fire I took from
his ruin is mine now.{end_wait}
Then what do you want with\nus? With Isaac?{end_wait}

Your lighthouses are doors.
Each one wakes the sleepers
and feeds the flame.{page_break}Kill the awakened and the
door closes. Quick, clean.
I only need you to choose.{end_wait}
She's telling the truth,\nIsaac. And she's afraid. I\ncan hear it.{end_wait}
Do it. Then it ends.{end_wait}
You went down to the pier.\nThat child is still\nbreathing, Isaac.{end_wait}
You stayed with that miner\nuntil it passed. I saw.{end_wait}
You opened the door. I can\nstill hear her humming.{end_wait}
Forty of them were awake,\nand you walked in without\na weapon drawn.{end_wait}
You left the blade with me.\nI haven't decided if that\nwas kind.{end_wait}
Not one mercy, Isaac. You\nand I are the same\nalready.{end_wait}
Take her offer?{end_now}
Do it. End it quickly.{end_wait}
Good. Close your eyes,\nIsaac. It's faster that\nway.{end_wait}
They've gone quiet. All of\nthem. Isaac, what did you\ndo?{end_wait}
He did what I asked.\nWelcome, Isaac.{end_wait}
No. We'll find another\nway, and I'll carry what\nit costs.{end_wait}
Then carry it. The sleepers\nwill still wake. Remember\nthat I offered.{end_wait}
I'll hear every one of\nthem, Isaac. I'm staying.{end_wait}
Fine. The blade stays quiet\nfor now, but I'm watching\nyou, Isaac.{end_wait}
I won't do it. Not that.{end_wait}
Then I'll wait. People like\nyou always come around.{end_wait}
He's soft and you know it.\nI'm done waiting on him.{end_wait}
Mia, don't do this! Come\nback!{end_wait}
Your Jenna, Kraden and\nFelix are still Menardi's.{page_break}The Wise One has noticed\nyou now. Hurry to Kalay.{end_wait}
